content: If development error detection for the FrIf module is enabled: if the function FrIf_GetSyncFrameList is called before the Fr was initialized successfully, 80 of 162 Document ID 27: AUTOSAR_SWS_FlexRayInterface Specification of FlexRay Interface AUTOSAR CP R22-11 the function FrIf_GetSyncFrameList shall raise the development error FRIF_E_UNINIT and return E_NOT_OK.
